text: On April 14, 2020, the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (the “LPAT”) issued a decision approving, in part, the Zoning By-law Amendment Application made pursuant to subsection 34(11) of the Planning Act for the properties at 445-451 Adelaide Street West (the "Development Site"). The Local Planning Appeal Tribunal Act allows the parties to a hearing to seek leave to appeal a decision of the LPAT to the Divisional Court. The City Solicitor requires further directions.

City Council on July 28 and 29, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 21, 2020) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 21, 2020) from the City Solicitor at the discretion of the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 21, 2020) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice and information that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
